tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Nova Lands for MultiWorld.
tutorials.text:
# How to use
- Install MelonLoader
- Drop the Mod and its Dependency in the mods folder

notes.text:
# What's new?
- fixed museum locations not sending for completed rooms
- removed Mass Production I from the start inventory (not sure what my reasoning for that was)
# How to use
- Install the latest version of [MelonLoader](https://melonwiki.xyz/#/?id=automated-installation)
- place ``NovaLandsArchipelago.dll`` and ``Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dl`` in the Mods folder
- connect to a slot via the box on the left of the screen
# What's randomized?
- Researches are locations
- Museum progress and boss defeats are optional locations
- research is received as an item (it has to be researched again to get the effect. if you don't have the item it won't take resources and only send the check)
# Goal options
- Each of the three bosses
- a configurable number of museum dioramas complete
# This release should be compatible with 0.2.x
